reproduce.title: Reproduce Workspaces behavior
prerequisites: A saved workspace with at least two apps and a PC that can sleep/resume.
setup: Create and save a workspace with applications at known positions.
steps: Launch the workspace and confirm positions.
Move windows, close them, and put the PC to sleep.
Resume and launch the same saved workspace shortcut.
reproduce.expected_result: Workspace launch should restore saved positions rather than positions from the prior session.
